component.summary: The local-first open-source Workspace for people and teams

description.p: The local-first open-source Workspace for people and teams. Our mission is to give our users the perfect balance of simplicity, privacy, and productivity. Made with love ❤️ in 🇪🇺!

ul.li: Markdown support for rich text formatting

description.p: This beta release brings a redesigned onboarding experience, improved synchronization, stronger encryption, and a number of usability and performance improvements.

ul.li: Redesigned onboarding with improved animations and stability.
Added table merge and split operations.
Added an exit button when searching in the editor.
Fixed loading of larger images and media files.
Improved the emoji picker and empty states.
Added ARMv8 AES/PMULL hardware acceleration for Apple Silicon.
Improved Mermaid diagram rendering with beautiful-mermaid.
Fixed label duplication and portable data location issues.
Improved application performance, error handling, and overall stability.
Numerous internal improvements to code organization, type safety, and development tooling.
